verdict.rationale: The README documents a first-party `edge0 serve edge0-35b` command that exposes an OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint on localhost:8000, with a curl example. Edge0 models load from directories with tier auto-detection, so the core story is delivered from GitHub docs alone. Missing for 10: evidence that serve accepts arbitrary model directories beyond named Edge0 tiers, documentation of other OpenAI endpoints (completions, models, embeddings) and server options, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
